hook.note: Volume 2 is the volume where He speaks most — 75,870 words across 3,070 verses, more than either of the other two. Job through Malachi is the poetry and the prophets, and in every other Bible the moment the narrator stops and our Father starts is invisible. Here the sentence changes color, at 14 point, on a line wide enough to keep the poetry in its own shape.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.

Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Across the whole Bible our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies.

This is Volume 2 of the three-volume Large Print edition: the Old Testament, Job through Malachi, 22 books in full text — 493 chapters and 10,274 verses, not abridged. In this volume our Father speaks 75,870 words across 3,070 verses, every one set apart in BLUE, and in Isaiah the Son's own words appear in RED. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

Set in 14-point type in a single column across the page, so every line reads whole and poetry keeps its shape. Most Bibles labelled large print are 10 to 12 point, and the ones that go bigger force the whole Bible into a single volume on thin paper — ghosting the text through from the other side, and too heavy to hold open. Three volumes on opaque white paper answer both. And the large print does more than enlarge the words: Divine Voice Color shows you who is speaking, so it serves your ear as well as your eye. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 570 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. The full opening pages — Abba Father, a message from Kevin and Shelly, Receiving Your Father, the Preface and About this Translation — are in every volume. A presentation page carries their name.
He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek. The three volumes together carry the complete Bible — 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

body: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) Large Print, Volume 2: the Old Testament, Job through Malachi. A color coded Bible set in 14-point type in a single column for comfortable reading — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.
In this volume our Father speaks 75,870 words across 3,070 verses, every one set apart in BLUE, and in Isaiah the Son's own words appear in RED.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Across the whole Bible our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.
God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6).

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.a: Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Song of Solomon, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations, Ezekiel, Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Amos, Obadiah, Jonah, Micah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah, Haggai, Zechariah and Malachi — 22 books in full text, 493 chapters, 10,274 verses. Nothing is abridged, summarized or left out.

faq.q: Do I need all three volumes?
faq.a: Only if you want the whole Bible. Volume 1 is Genesis–Esther in Wheat, Volume 2 is Job–Malachi in Sage, and Volume 3 is the New Testament in Mist Blue. Each stands on its own and each carries the full opening pages, so a single volume is a complete book to read — not a fragment. Volume 2 is the one most often bought alone, for the Psalms.

faq.q: How large is the print, really?
faq.a: True 14 point, set in a single column across the page. Most Bibles sold as large print are 10 to 12 point in two narrow columns. The single column matters most in this volume: the poetry of Job, the Psalms and the prophets keeps its own line breaks instead of being broken again by a narrow column.

Both are offered, 6 x 9, in the Sage cover. Paperback (ISBN 979-8-89307-340-9) if you are going to carry it and mark it; hardback (ISBN 979-8-89307-345-4) if it is a gift or it is going on a shelf for years. The interior is identical — 1,142 pages, full color throughout.

faq.q: Why are the Son's words in RED in an Old Testament volume?
faq.a: Because the color marks who owns the words, not which Testament they sit in. In Isaiah the Son speaks in His own voice, so those words are RED here, exactly as they would be in a Gospel. Our Father's words are BLUE throughout, and narration stays black.
